metadata.case_name: LO KWOK FAI v. NGAN CHEUNG WAH

plaintiff.occupation_before: self-employed taxi driver working the night shift
plaintiff.occupation_after: shampoo boy in a hairdressing establishment

injuries.description: Two subdural haematomas revealed on CT scan of the brain
source: was given a CT scan of the brain, which revealed the existence of two subdural haematomas
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic subdural haemorrhage, unspecified whether acute or chronic

injuries.description: Fracture of the radius and ulna of his right forearm requiring open reduction and plating
source: The radius and ulna of his right forearm were fractured, and it was necessary for him to undergo an operation on his arm in which open reduction and plating was performed.

injuries.description: Fracture of the right acetabulum (hip) which did not require surgery
source: He also suffered a fracture of the right acetabulum, but this did not require surgery.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of acetabulum without disruption of pelvic ring

injuries.description: Deterioration in vision with a mild macular scar and a small choroidal crack nasal to the disc in his right eye, and mild cellophane maculopathy in his left eye
source: confirmed that his vision was affected, with a mild macular scar and a small choroidal crack nasal to the disc in his right eye, and mild cellophane maculopathy in his left eye.

manifestations.description: rendered unconscious for a short time not more than one hour and perhaps rather less
headaches for up to 45 minutes twice a day
cannot stand for very long (not more than about half an hour) without feeling discomfort and pain
sitting for long periods (over two or three hours) causes discomfort
tires more easily than he would have done had it not been for the accident
loss of libido and his sex life has suffered
lost much interest in life, rarely socialising with his friends, and doing relatively little around the house

treatments_received: open reduction and plating of right forearm
hospital admissions (Prince of Wales Hospital; United Christian Hospital)
treatments_future: possible removal of metal plate (claimed but not accepted by the court)

losses.description: deterioration in his vision with a mild macular scar and a small choroidal crack nasal to the disc in his right eye, and mild cellophane maculopathy in his left eye

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: unable to enjoy his former hobbies of playing football and jogging
cannot stand for very long (not more than about half an hour) without feeling discomfort and pain; sitting for long periods causes discomfort

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: doing relatively little around the house
lost much interest in life, rarely socialising with his friends

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: loss of libido and his sex life with his wife has suffered

comparable_cases.case_name: Tsang Hing Yuen v Nishimatsu Kumagai Joint Venture
comparable_cases.injury_description: fractures of the left wrist and hip, requiring hospitalisation for 6 months, and leaving him with residual pain, weakness and numbness, together with headaches, giddiness and general irritability
